environment.description: Same application deployed on EC2 in a private subnet. S3 traffic is routed exclusively through a VPC Gateway Endpoint (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) with an endpoint policy. The endpoint policy document uses a Condition block with StringEquals on 's3:prefix' combined with a Resource restriction limiting access to 'arn:aws:s3:::prod-sync-data-7f3a/*' only. Additionally, the endpoint policy includes a Condition 'aws:PrincipalOrgID' equals 'o-abc123def4' and 'StringLike' on 's3:prefix' restricting to 'sync/tenant-*/data/*' pattern. The private subnet route table has no internet gateway route; all S3 API calls MUST traverse the VPC endpoint. DNS resolution for s3.amazonaws.com resolves to the VPC endpoint's private IPs via private DNS enabled on the endpoint.
